text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What a stunning race! Silence Suzuka
wowed
every single spectator here
today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She comes running toward me as she
leaves the
crowd's cheers behind.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka! You were A-MA-ZING out
there!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Thank you! I had a lot of fun!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It felt like the whole world fell
silent—everything
but the wind and my
heartbeat...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Just like the first time I ever raced.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I think it was even more
peaceful and
beautiful!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her so happy and excited, I end
up with a
big smile of my own.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
We should have a party back at the
dorm! We
gotta celebrate Suzuka having
such a fun race!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, I notice a figure standing at
the tunnel
entrance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems Silence Suzuka's performance in
today's Kinko Sho has lit an unexpected
fire in the hearts
of some of the other
Umamusume.
